topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences II – mixed with negations
title: Second Conditional: Positive and Negative Mix

explanation.tr:
İkinci tip koşulda olumlu ve olumsuz biçimleri birlikte kullanırız.
• If + past simple / didn't + fiil / were / weren't
• Ana cümle: would / wouldn't + fiil
• If I had a dog, I wouldn't feel lonely.
• If she didn't work so hard, she would have more free time.
• İpucu: gerçek durum çoğu zaman tam tersidir. 'If I weren't ill, I would come.' → Aslında hastayım ve gelemiyorum.
explanation.tk:
Ikinji görnüşli şertde tassyklaýjy we ýokluk görnüşlerini bilelikde ulanýarys.
• If + past simple / didn't + işlik / were / weren't
• Esasy bölek: would / wouldn't + işlik
• If I had a dog, I wouldn't feel lonely.
• If she didn't work so hard, she would have more free time.
• Maslahat: hakyky ýagdaý köplenç tersine bolýar. 'If I weren't ill, I would come.' → Aslynda men syrkaw, gelip bilemok.
explanation.ru:
Во втором типе мы сочетаем утвердительные и отрицательные формы.
• If + past simple / didn't + глагол / were / weren't
• Главная часть: would / wouldn't + глагол
• If I had a dog, I wouldn't feel lonely.
• If she didn't work so hard, she would have more free time.
• Подсказка: реальность обычно противоположна. 'If I weren't ill, I would come.' → На самом деле я болен и не приду.

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences II, Exercise – easy
title: Second Conditional: Easy Practice

explanation.tr:
İkinci tip koşul = hayal ettiğimiz durumlar.
• If + past simple, would + fiil
• If I had a cat, I would call it Max.
• Fiilin ikinci hâlini kullan: go → went, have → had, can → could.
• be → were: If I were a teacher, ...
Kolay bir yol: 'olsaydı ... -ardı/-erdi' diye düşün.
explanation.tk:
Ikinji görnüşli şert = göz öňüne getirýän ýagdaýlarymyz.
• If + past simple, would + işlik
• If I had a cat, I would call it Max.
• Işligiň ikinji görnüşini ulan: go → went, have → had, can → could.
• be → were: If I were a teacher, ...
Aňsat ýol: '... bolsady, ... -ardy/-erdi' diýip pikir et.
explanation.ru:
Второй тип = то, что мы воображаем.
• If + past simple, would + глагол
• If I had a cat, I would call it Max.
• Используй вторую форму глагола: go → went, have → had, can → could.
• be → were: If I were a teacher, ...
Простой способ: думай «если бы ..., то бы ...».

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences II, Exercise – medium
title: Second Conditional: Medium Practice

explanation.tr:
Orta seviye ikinci tip koşul alıştırması: düzensiz fiiller, could/might ve sorular.
• Düzensiz fiiller: buy → bought, know → knew, find → found, win → won
• would yerine: could (yapabilirdi), might (belki yapardı)
  If I had more time, I might learn Chinese.
• Soru: Would you tell her if you knew the truth?
• Unutma: if kısmında asla would kullanılmaz.
explanation.tk:
Ikinji görnüşli şert boýunça orta derejeli gönükme: nädogry işlikler, could/might we soraglar.
• Nädogry işlikler: buy → bought, know → knew, find → found, win → won
• would ýerine: could (edip bilerdi), might (belki ederdi)
  If I had more time, I might learn Chinese.
• Sorag: Would you tell her if you knew the truth?
• Ýatda sakla: if böleginde hiç haçan would ulanylmaýar.
explanation.ru:
Упражнение среднего уровня: неправильные глаголы, could/might и вопросы.
• Неправильные глаголы: buy → bought, know → knew, find → found, win → won
• Вместо would: could (мог бы), might (возможно бы)
  If I had more time, I might learn Chinese.
• Вопрос: Would you tell her if you knew the truth?
• Помни: в части с if никогда не бывает would.

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences – type III – negations
title: Third Conditional: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Üçüncü tip koşul cümlesi (Third Conditional) geçmişte olmamış durumları ve sonuçlarını anlatır; artık değiştirilemez.
• Yapı: If + had + V3 (past participle), would have + V3
• If I had studied, I would have passed. (Çalışmadım, geçemedim.)
• Olumsuz if kısmı: If + hadn't + V3
  If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
• Olumsuz ana cümle: wouldn't have + V3
• Kısaltmalar: I'd (= I had / I would), hadn't, wouldn't've (konuşmada).
explanation.tk:
Üçünji görnüşli şert sözlemi (Third Conditional) geçmişde bolmadyk ýagdaýlary we olaryň netijelerini aňladýar; olary indi üýtgedip bolmaýar.
• Gurluşy: If + had + V3 (past participle), would have + V3
• If I had studied, I would have passed. (Okamadym, geçmedim.)
• If böleginde ýokluk: If + hadn't + V3
  If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
• Esasy bölekde ýokluk: wouldn't have + V3
• Gysgaltmalar: I'd (= I had / I would), hadn't, wouldn't've (gürleşikde).
explanation.ru:
Условные предложения третьего типа (Third Conditional) описывают то, чего не произошло в прошлом, и его последствия; изменить это уже нельзя.
• Схема: If + had + V3 (past participle), would have + V3
• If I had studied, I would have passed. (Я не учил и не сдал.)
• Отрицание в части с if: If + hadn't + V3
  If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
• Отрицание в главной части: wouldn't have + V3
• Сокращения: I'd (= I had / I would), hadn't, wouldn't've (в речи).

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences I – II
title: First or Second Conditional?

explanation.tr:
Birinci mi ikinci tip mi? Karar, durumun ne kadar gerçek olduğuna bağlıdır.
• Birinci tip (gerçek, mümkün): If + present simple, will + fiil
  If I find your book, I will bring it. (Bulabilirim.)
• İkinci tip (hayali, pek mümkün değil): If + past simple, would + fiil
  If I found a dinosaur, I would call the news. (Pek olası değil.)
• Aynı konu, farklı anlam:
  If I have time, I will help you. (Zamanım olabilir.)
  If I had time, I would help you. (Zamanım yok.)
explanation.tk:
Birinji ýa-da ikinji görnüş? Saýlaw ýagdaýyň näçe hakykydygyna bagly.
• Birinji görnüş (hakyky, mümkin): If + present simple, will + işlik
  If I find your book, I will bring it. (Tapyp bilerin.)
• Ikinji görnüş (hyýaly, kän mümkin däl): If + past simple, would + işlik
  If I found a dinosaur, I would call the news. (Kän ähtimal däl.)
• Şol bir tema, başga many:
  If I have time, I will help you. (Wagtym bolup biler.)
  If I had time, I would help you. (Wagtym ýok.)
explanation.ru:
Первый или второй тип? Всё зависит от того, насколько ситуация реальна.
• Первый тип (реально, возможно): If + present simple, will + глагол
  If I find your book, I will bring it. (Вполне могу найти.)
• Второй тип (воображаемо, маловероятно): If + past simple, would + глагол
  If I found a dinosaur, I would call the news. (Вряд ли.)
• Одна тема — разный смысл:
  If I have time, I will help you. (Время может быть.)
  If I had time, I would help you. (Времени нет.)
